headline: What’s on, and what’s next through December.
lede: Comic movies and series currently in play — plus the remaining slate through New Year’s Eve.

titles.title: Lanterns
titles.blurb: New recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan — two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery with cosmic ties as they investigate a murder in the American heartland. From HBO, Warner Bros. Television, and DC Studios; weekly Sundays through the Oct 4 finale.
titles.where_override: HBO / Max · airing now · through Oct 4

titles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
titles.blurb: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him — and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him — sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves: a powerful villain no one can even see.

titles.title: Supergirl
titles.blurb: In its inaugural flight into the new DC Universe, Supergirl reveals the origin of the interplanetary nomad Kara Zor-El — cousin of Kal-El, better known as Superman. Headstrong, worldly-wise, and often reckless, she exudes a brand of heroism all her own. When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic interstellar journey — balancing vengeance with justice, and fighting to save her best friend, Krypto.

titles.title: X-Men ’97
titles.blurb: Season 1 left the X-Men reeling after loss, betrayal, and a future that still threatens mutantkind. Season 2 picks up with the team divided and thrown across different eras in time — from the dawn of Apocalypse’s reign to the height of his rule — as they struggle to find their way home. Meanwhile, back in the 1990s, suspicious foes and new strains of mutant intolerance rise in the wake of their absence.

titles.title: Avengers: Endgame
titles.blurb: Encore theatrical run with roughly four minutes of new footage — a warm-up for Doomsday.

titles.title: VisionQuest
titles.blurb: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive — while a mysterious boy who may be his son is drawn into the chase.

titles.title: Clayface
titles.blurb: Follow the terrifying descent of a promising Hollywood actor who becomes a monster driven by revenge — a story about the loss of identity and humanity, toxic love, and the dark side of scientific ambition.
titles.date_note: North America Oct 23; international from Oct 21

titles.title: Avengers: Doomsday
titles.blurb: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
